description: Shared platform policy for artifact/report output download grants and retention execution planning.
path_rules: absolute paths, UNC paths, drive-qualified paths, and parent traversal are invalid
download grants must be built from DB metadata records that currently exist
retention_approval_rule: retention execution plans must include approved_by, approved_at, reason, dry_run, and at least one candidate
planning records do not delete, archive, or move files
actual delete/archive workers must consume approved plans in the platform repository
